citation: Abendpost (Chicago), 22 March 1904, vol. 16, no. 69, 'Gewaltsames Ende': the report of a labourer buried and killed by falling earth that day while digging a foundation at No. 1605-1613 Indiana Ave.
author: Abendpost
locator: The local news, 'Gewaltsames Ende': '... wurde heute, während er mit dem Ausgraben eines Fundaments, Nr. 1605 1613 Indiana Ave., beschäftigt war, unter auf ihn stürzenden Erdmassen verschüttet.'
rights_note: A US newspaper published in 1904, in the public domain. Read for a date and a place.
access_notes: Found 2026-10-24 (T-3068) through the Internet Archive's full-text search for "1613 Indiana"; German-language OCR.
note: The ice-cream plant's foundation was being dug in March 1904, three and a half months before the scene date: the 1886 houses were gone and the four-storey factory was not yet up.
what_it_supplies: 1605-1613 Indiana was an excavation for a foundation in March 1904
what_it_does_not_supply: how far the building had risen by 1 July 1904
